examples.text_zh: 他们为学校举办了一场募捐演出。

examples.text_en: Her fund-raising work helped many local people.
examples.text_zh: 她的募款工作帮助了许多当地人。

examples.text_en: The new school needs more funding this year.
examples.text_zh: 这所新学校今年需要更多资金。

examples.text_en: They cut the funding for the whole project.
examples.text_zh: 他们削减了整个项目的资金。

examples.text_en: The whole room had a funereal feel.
examples.text_zh: 整个房间有一种送葬般的悲凉气氛。

examples.text_en: A funereal song was played at the end.
examples.text_zh: 最后演奏了一首哀伤的乐曲。

examples.text_en: Many small fungi grew on the old tree.
examples.text_zh: 那棵老树上长出了许多小真菌。

examples.text_en: They study fungi and other small life.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究真菌和其他微小生物。

examples.text_en: They used a fungicide on the young plants.
examples.text_zh: 他们给幼苗用了杀真菌剂。

examples.text_en: This fungicide is safe for the food we eat.
examples.text_zh: 这种杀真菌剂对我们吃的食物是安全的。

examples.text_en: A white fungus grew on the old wall.
examples.text_zh: 旧墙上长出了一片白色的真菌。

examples.text_en: They found a fungus under the wet ground.
examples.text_zh: 他们在潮湿的地面下发现了一种真菌。

examples.text_en: They used a funnel to fill the small box.
examples.text_zh: 他们用漏斗把那个小盒子装满。

examples.text_en: Water went down the funnel into the cup.
examples.text_zh: 水顺着漏斗流进了杯子。

examples.text_en: They worked all day to furbish the old house.
examples.text_zh: 他们干了一整天来翻新那座老房子。

examples.text_en: He would furbish the gold ring until it shone.
examples.text_zh: 他会把金戒指擦得发亮。

examples.text_en: The old furnace gave out a lot of heat.
examples.text_zh: 旧火炉散发出大量的热。

examples.text_en: They kept the furnace going all through the night.
examples.text_zh: 他们让火炉整夜烧着。

examples.text_en: They will furnish the new house next week.
examples.text_zh: 他们下周会给新房子配置家具。

examples.text_en: He can furnish us with all the facts we need.
examples.text_zh: 他能向我们提供我们所需的全部事实。

examples.text_en: There was a great furor over the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 新计划引起了轩然大波。

examples.text_en: The whole furor died down after a week.
examples.text_zh: 一周之后，这场风波平息了下来。

examples.text_en: A deep furrow was cut across the land.
examples.text_zh: 一道深沟横穿这片土地。

examples.text_en: The old man had a furrow on his face.
examples.text_zh: 老人脸上有一道皱纹。

examples.text_en: He gave a furtive look around the room.
examples.text_zh: 他偷偷地环视了一下房间。

examples.text_en: Their furtive talk made the others feel unsure.
examples.text_zh: 他们鬼鬼祟祟的谈话让其他人心里没底。
